setup_welcome: Welcome to the setup wizard! Here you can calibrate your lights and create a new setup. Make sure go through this wizard on a computer! This process will take about 20-30 minutes and you need a webcam in front of the lights. In case you don't have a webcam, you can use a phone app like DroidCam to use your phone as a webcam. Click next to start the setup process.
setup_instruction_intro: Follow these steps to set up your lights:
setup_instruction_place_lights: Place the lights in the desired position.
setup_instruction_mount_webcam: Ensure the webcam is securely mounted in a position to capture all lights.
setup_instruction_3d: For a 3D setup, make sure to mark the position of the object you mount the lights on, so you don't move sideways it while rotating.
setup_instruction_click_start: Click "Start Calibration" to begin the calibration process.
upload_header: Drag and drop or click to upload files!
upload_description: Supported files: Effects (.py), Audio files (.wav, .ogg, .mp3), Lightshows (.json), Lightshow Effects (.py), Images (.png, .jpg, .jpeg), Videos (.mp4)
